name: [UPD] Infection Battlegrounds
desc:
🧪 Welcome to Infection Grounds, turn opponents into infected helpers to fight or experiment with different mutation combos!

[How to play]
• 🧬 Infect NPCs or Players to turn them into your helpers, they fight for you!
• 💥 Battle other players, earn points, unlock new effects
• 📈 Use different effects to enhance your army & grow your army!

🌐 Play on any device! (PC, MOBILE, CONSOLE)
🔥 Private servers are FREE to use!
Thanks for playing!
